contract: OwnedBytes is a built-in sealed alloc capability, not a public user-constructible class
Only canonical trusted stdlib linkage may call the raw byte primitive; guest code cannot forge region handles, pointers, owner/generation identifiers or capability tokens
allocate_zeroed rejects negative sizes and overflow before allocation; honors the active TenantVM and actor limits; zeroes logical length before publication
byte indices use checked integer access, forbid host signed-char/JS signed32 coercion and do not permit endianness-dependent interpretation
read_byte and write_byte never suspend or allocate after successful admission
write_byte must be infallible for a live exclusive loan, preflight-verified index and octet; host faults must never become partial ordinary source throws after first write
region length is stable throughout a verified byte write; no simultaneous mutable or readonly aliases may invalidate its backing storage
region deallocation happens once after all pinned users retire; stale borrowed views and stale handle generations fail closed
no ambient socket, file, system allocator, GC, or FFI privilege is conferred by raw byte access
compiler must enforce direct and transitive import privileges; lexical source checks are insufficient
typed BufferBoundsError BufferValueError BufferAllocationError and TenantQuotaError are Error subclasses; source throw, trap and Result semantics apply
failure to implement this ABI requires deterministic unsupported diagnostics and no executable guest artifact
